Tamil Nadu Government Plans Secretariat Relocation to New Campus

The Tamil Nadu government is planning to relocate its Secretariat to a new, sprawling campus. This move is intended to consolidate government offices and improve administrative efficiency. The new campus is designed to house various departments, aiming to streamline operations and provide a modern working environment for government employees. The project is part of a larger initiative to upgrade state infrastructure and enhance public service delivery. Further details regarding the timeline and specific departments involved are expected.
